map.根据蚀刻液浓度和温度估算蚀刻速率，计算达到目标深度所需时间: Estimate the etch rate from etchant concentration and temperature, and compute the time to reach the target depth.
map.速率 ∝ Q₁₀^(T/10)（范特霍夫规则，Q₁₀≈2）: Rate proportional to Q10^(T/10) (van t Hoff rule, Q10 approx 2).
map.基于湿法蚀刻速率温度模型：依据范特霍夫规则（温度每升 10℃ 速率约翻倍，Q₁₀: Based on the wet-etching rate-temperature model: per the van t Hoff rule (rate roughly doubles per 10 deg C rise, Q10 approx 2), combined with concentration and target etch depth, compute the required etch time, for etch process control.
map.💡 蚀刻速率 = 1.0 × (浓度/40)^0.8 × 2^((温度-50)/: Formula: etch rate = 1.0 times (concentration/40)^0.8 times 2^((temperature-50)/10) um/min; time = depth / rate; every 10 deg C rise roughly doubles the rate.
map.默认参考氯化铁蚀刻铜的典型速率，其他材料需修正: Default references the typical rate of ferric chloride etching copper; other materials need correction.
map.实际蚀刻速率受搅拌、新旧液、铜箔厚度等因素影响: Actual etch rate is affected by agitation, fresh/old solution and copper thickness.
map.建议通过试蚀刻校准实际速率后再批量使用: It is recommended to calibrate the actual rate by a trial etch before batch use.
map.📚 深度解析：蚀刻时间计算（速率、温度与浓度影响）: In-depth: Etching time calculation (rate, temperature and concentration effects)
map.工艺配方：由蚀刻液浓度与温度估算达到目标深度所需时间: Process formulation: estimate the time to reach the target depth from etchant concentration and temperature.
map.温控评估：量化温度波动对蚀刻速率与均匀性的影响: Temperature control assessment: quantify the effect of temperature fluctuation on etch rate and uniformity.
map.过蚀刻预留：按 10% 过蚀刻量核算总作业时间: Over-etch allowance: budget total job time with 10% over-etch.
map.算法：基准速率 1.0μm/min（40% 浓度、50℃ 条件下）；浓度系数 =: Algorithm: base rate 1.0 um/min (at 40% concentration, 50 deg C); concentration factor = (concentration/40)^0.8; temperature factor = 2^((temperature-50)/10), i.e. doubling per 10 deg C rise; etch rate = 1.0 times concentration factor times temperature factor; time needed = target depth / rate (min); with 10% over-etch time = depth times 1.1 / rate. Hint: rate <0.5 um/min suggests raising temperature or concentration, >5 um/min watch over-etch risk.
map.例：浓度 40%、温度 50℃、目标深度 35μm → 速率 1.000μm/m: Example: concentration 40%, temperature 50 deg C, target depth 35 um -> rate 1.000 um/min, time 35.0 min (2100 s), temperature factor 1.00, concentration factor 1.00, with 10% over-etch 38.5 min, verdict: moderate rate, reasonable parameters. If temperature raised to 60 deg C -> temperature factor 2.00, rate 2.000 um/min, time down to 17.5 min. If temperature dropped to 30 deg C -> temperature factor 0.25, rate 0.250 um/min, time extended to 140.0 min, hint: low rate, raise temperature or concentration. If concentration raised to 80% -> concentration factor 1.741, rate 1.741 um/min, time 20.1 min.
map.温度每升高 10℃ 速率翻倍，依据是什么？: What is the basis that rate doubles every 10 deg C?
map.这是化学反应速率的经验规律（范特霍夫规则/Q₁₀ 温度系数），对多数湿法蚀刻在窄: This is the empirical law of chemical reaction rate (van t Hoff rule / Q10 temperature coefficient), valid for most wet etches over a narrow temperature band. Different etch systems differ greatly in activation energy; some have Q10 near 2, some only about 1.5; the formal process should fit the measured rate curve.
map.由于速率对温度极敏感，槽液温差 2℃ 就会带来约 15% 的速率差（2^(2/1: Because the rate is highly temperature-sensitive, a 2 deg C bath difference yields about 15% rate difference (2^(2/10)=1.149), directly showing as uneven etch depth across the workpiece. Hence precise etching needs circulation agitation and tight temperature control, keeping the bath within plusminus 1 deg C.
